name: Emerge Technologies
summary: Kalgoorlie ISP/IT firm, formed 1999 by the merger of Ludin Computers (also trading as Goldfields-Esperance Internet) and GoldNet; spun the ISP side back to GoldNet ~2013 (EMERGE TECHNOLOGIES PTY LTD, ACN 087 855 221).

events.details: Founded July 1999 from the merger of Ludin Computers (trading as Goldfields-Esperance Internet) and Goldnet Internet Services.
ISP side of the business spun back to GoldNet; Emerge continued as carrier-grade network services firm.
